summary: Parses a count-prefixed typed buffer into per-type handler objects. Iterates a3 entries of buffer a2. For each entry it fetches the handler via the vtable slot at offset 0x58 of the sub-struct at this+0x414 (this[261]), compares the entry type byte against the handler's expected type size ((field36>>3)+((field36&7)!=0)), copies the fixed-size entry data into the handler at offset 20 when they match, then reads a trailing length byte and copies that variable-length payload into the handler at offset 8 via MemcpyLikeWithRealloc, stamps the config value a4 at handler offset 4, and dispatches the handler through VTableDispatchWithConditionalBranch. Returns the last dispatch result (initialized to a3).

operations.description: Walk a3 entries of buffer a2; the cursor advances by each parsed entry's size and the loop terminates when it reaches a3.
Fetch the per-entry handler object by invoking the vtable slot at offset 0x58 on the sub-struct at this+0x414 (this[261]).
Read the entry type byte at buffer position i and compute the handler's expected type size from its field at offset 36: (field36 >> 3) + ((field36 & 7) != 0).
When the type byte equals the expected type size, copy the fixed-size entry data into the handler buffer at offset 20.
Read the variable-length payload length byte and copy that many bytes into the handler at offset 8 via MemcpyLikeWithRealloc.
Store the configuration value a4 into the handler at offset 4.
Dispatch the built handler through VTableDispatchWithConditionalBranch on the sub-struct at this+0x414; its result is retained across iterations.
Advance the loop cursor by the parsed entry size (type byte + length byte + data length).
Return the last dispatch result (initialized to a3); invoked by sub_584230 (00584230).
